title: scripts: delete the committed one-off codemod-split-*.mjs scripts and the comments that point at them
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRsWwTRkuRCyQwvpAG

Maintainer order, project chat 2026-11-16 (「yes」 to the clean-up step after 「这种代码就是垃圾啊…」). It is an explicit exception to the current no-new-claims wind-down.

**What.** Four one-off split scripts sit on main, about 15,900 lines. No code, gate, CI workflow or package script runs or imports any of them; only comments and headers name them.

| script | lines | files naming it |
|---|--:|--:|
| `scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs` | 7,452 | 43 |
| `scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs` | 4,164 | 13 |
| `scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs` | 2,950 | 29 |
| `scripts/codemod-split-conversions-registry.mjs` | 1,367 | 118 |

**Change.**
- Delete the four scripts.
- Reword every comment that names one (module headers, gate banners such as `regen-artifacts.mjs`, `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs`, `sql-driver-split-source.mjs`, `cross-package-test-inputs.mjs`) so it names the PR that made the split instead.
- Comments only: no code change. Re-measure the "nothing runs them" claim on the branch with `git grep`.
- Do not touch `scripts/codemod/` (customer migration codemods, a different kind of tool).

**Done when** the scripts are gone, `git grep codemod-split-` finds nothing outside the changeset, every gate is green, and the PR has landed. Over 3,000 changed lines makes it Tier H, so the seat hands it to the maintainer.

Related: the review-rule card filed beside this one; #33949; #34285.
